stories.title: Hitzesommer in den Bergen – Wenig Wasser, wenig Probleme: SAC-Hütten kommen glimpflich davon

en.title: Hot summer in the mountains – Little water, few problems: SAC mountain huts weather the season well
en.summary: SAC mountain huts experienced a record summer due to heat but escaped major difficulties. Climate change costs the SAC millions annually.

stories.title: IWC Schaffhausen, de l’établi à l’espace: l’ingénierie horlogère en mouvement

en.title: IWC Schaffhausen, from workbench to space: watchmaking engineering in motion
en.summary: IWC's Innovation Lab in Geneva showcases three technological advances: a reversible calendar, high-performance ceramics, and a space-designed watch. The exhibition explores the hidden engineering work behind these watchmaking innovations.

stories.title: En direct, Moyen-Orient – Des frappes saoudiennes rapportées sur la ville de Mokha, au Yémen

en.title: Live, Middle East – Saudi strikes reported on the city of Mokha in Yemen
en.summary: Saudi strikes on the Yemeni city of Mokha killed at least six people according to a Houthi-affiliated source. The G7 called on the Houthis to immediately stop military operations against maritime shipping.

stories.title: «Trente F-35 ce n’est pas assez», estime le chef de l’armée suisse en visite au Texas

en.title: "Thirty F-35s is not enough," says Swiss military chief during Texas visit
en.summary: Switzerland's military chief visited the F-35 production facility in Texas and stated that thirty aircraft are insufficient. He is already considering increasing the budget for this acquisition program despite rising costs.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Der Mut zur unbequemen Wahrheit: Die Kriegsverhinderung in Europa verlangt einen gemeinsamen Willensakt

en.title: COMMENT - The courage for uncomfortable truth: Preventing war in Europe requires a joint act of will
en.summary: Russia is intensifying attacks on European democracies. To protect freedom and open debate, authorities must clearly identify the threat, including in Switzerland.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Bericht: EU will Sanktionen gegen zwei Oligarchen kippen

en.title: War in Ukraine – Report: EU wants to lift sanctions against two oligarchs
en.summary: The EU is considering removing sanctions against two oligarchs, as their continued designation threatens to block the renewal of other existing sanctions measures.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – USA wollen Irans Fluggesellschaften weltweit isolieren

en.title: Middle East War – USA wants to isolate Iran's airlines worldwide
en.summary: The United States threatens to impose sanctions on third countries that continue providing services to Iranian airlines starting Wednesday.

stories.title: App für alles – Russlands Super-App Max ermöglicht weitreichende Überwachung

en.title: App for everything – Russia's Super-App Max enables extensive surveillance
en.summary: Russia's Super-App Max collects extensive user data. Research reveals the scope of surveillance capabilities integrated into the application.

stories.title: Philip Lane, de la BCE: «L’inflation va être plus élevée et plus durable qu’on ne le pensait précédemment»

en.title: Philip Lane, ECB: "Inflation will be higher and more persistent than previously thought"
en.summary: An ECB board member suggests that energy price increases will drive food and electricity costs higher. Return to the 2% inflation target is not expected until mid-2027.

stories.title: Wer in Rom lebe, werde unweigerlich krank, schrieb der Satiriker Juvenal: Michael Sommer zeigt die dunklen Seiten der antiken Weltstadt

en.title: He who lived in Rome would inevitably become sick, wrote the satirist Juvenal: Michael Sommer shows the dark sides of the ancient metropolis
en.summary: A German historian explores the less glamorous aspects of ancient Rome beyond emperors and military victories, examining the dirt, poverty, and dangers of the empire's back alleys.

stories.title: Le Conseil des Etats approuve une hausse de 0,2 point de la TVA pour financer l’armée

en.title: Council of States approves 0.2 percentage point VAT increase to fund military
en.summary: Switzerland's upper chamber approved a modest VAT increase for defense spending, below the federal government's initial 0.8 point request, with the matter proceeding to the lower chamber before a 2028 public vote.

stories.title: Le Conseil des Etats approuve une hausse de la TVA pour financer l'armée

en.title: Council of States approves VAT increase to finance the military
en.summary: Switzerland's Council of States has approved a value-added tax increase intended to fund military spending.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Der Mut zur unbequemen Wahrheit: Die Kriegsverhinderung in Europa verlangt einen gemeinsamen Willensakt

en.title: COMMENT - The courage for uncomfortable truth: Preventing war in Europe requires a joint act of will
en.summary: Russia is intensifying attacks on European democracies. To protect freedom and open debate, authorities must clearly identify the threat, including in Switzerland.

stories.title: «Empörend» – «Ich finde es wichtig, dass auf die negativen Folgen der Regulierung hingewiesen wird»: Die Aussagen von Sergio Ermotti geben im Ständerat zu reden

en.title: "Outrageous" – "I think it's important to point out the negative consequences of regulation": Sergio Ermotti's statements spark debate in the Council of States
en.summary: Parliament will decide Wednesday on UBS's future capital requirements in a critical decision for the major bank. The bank's chief has strongly criticized the responsible authorities in recent remarks.

stories.title: Russland könnte die Nato schon bald testen, sagen westliche Geheimdienste. Während Europa in Alarmismus verfällt, sind es auf einmal die Balten, die beschwichtigen

en.title: Russia could soon test NATO, say Western intelligence agencies. While Europe descends into alarmism, it is suddenly the Baltic states that call for calm
en.summary: Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania warned about Russia when the rest of Europe was not paying attention. Now they are urging caution and restraint.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Die USA sollten chinesische Direktinvestitionen anziehen», sagt der Ökonom Adam Posen

en.title: INTERVIEW - "The USA should attract Chinese direct investment," says economist Adam Posen
en.summary: Economist Adam Posen discusses areas where the US and China could reach understanding on contested issues ranging from AI competition to trade policy during Xi Jinping's visit.

stories.title: DATENANALYSE - Wie viel der Iran-Krieg die USA kostet

en.title: DATA ANALYSIS - How much the Iran war costs the USA
en.summary: American military operations against Iran and defensive measures protecting Middle Eastern allies involve billions in spending. The U.S. Defense Minister seeks additional funding for these operations.
